entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CollectionView iOS weird scrolling behavior #32809
  • Windows Reentrancy Crash with FontImageSource #32808
  • Alert popup not displaying when dismissing modal page on iOS/MacOS #32807
  • I can' upload my app to the Microsoft Store, because the Package Family Name (PFN) and the Publisher is wrong in the .msix file #32801
  • CollectionView2 on iOS iPad jumps/scrolls randomly when item size changes #32796
    .NET 10.0 SR3
  • [Android, iOS] CollectionView and CarouselView remain interactive when disabled #32791

Closed

  • TitleView not showing in iOS 26 - .NET10 #32777
  • Using custom TitleView in AppShell causes shell content to be covered in iOS 26 #32287
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • XAML parser errors are formatted incorrectly, so navigating to XAML doesn't work #13797
    Backlog
  • DisplayPrompt not working and not even showing... #32418
  • ToolTipProperties is not working properly for Mac Catalyst in .Net Maui #32399
  • The flyout icon is getting tinted on Android and loses colours (becomes monochromatic) #32495
  • Maui controls (CheckBox) alignment issue in .NET 10 compared to .NET 9 when placed inside Grid #32440

PullRequests

Created

  • Backport pipeline configuration fixes from PRs #32781 and #32803 #32806
  • [AI] The Issue-Resolver agent #32804
    community ✨
  • [Windows] Fix for crash when navigating to an existing page using SetTitleView in a Flyout menu on Windows #32800
    partner/syncfusion
  • [Testing] Feature matrix UITest Cases for Visual Transform Control #32799
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [iOS] Fix infinite update cycle in layout when applying TranslateToAsync with SafeArea #32797
    platform/ios, partner/syncfusion
  • Fix CollectionView selection color persisting incorrectly after scrolling on iOS 26.1 #32795
  • [Android, iOS] Fix for CollectionView and CarouselView remain interactive when disabled #32794
    platform/android, platform/ios, area-controls-collectionview, community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • [X] Fix VSM inheritance via BasedOn styles #32792
  • Fix for SwipeView Command Binding Issue in CollectionView Templates #32790
    area-controls-swipeview, partner/syncfusion
  • [Windows] Fix TitleBar color not applied to the Flyout icon background during initial loading #32789
    platform/windows, area-controls-titlebar, partner/syncfusion
  • Add XAML unit testing guidelines #32788
  • Fix race condition in RemoveInnerPage unit test #32787
  • Bumps Syncfusion.Maui.Toolkit dependency to version 1.0.8 #32786
    partner/syncfusion
  • Update iOS test lanes from 18.5 to 26.0 #32785
  • [PR-Reviewer] Standardize PR review output format with collapsible sections #32784
    community ✨, area-ai

Merged

  • Fix iOS 26 TitleView covering content in Shell and NavigationPage #32341
    p/0, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Update bug report template with new versions #32805
  • [release/10.0.1xx-sr1] [ci] Revert changes setting Creator #32803
  • Refactor device test stages in pipeline configuration #32712
  • [release/10.0.1xx-sr1] Fix iOS 26 TitleView covering content in Shell and NavigationPage #32798
  • Fix XAML parser error format for IDE navigation #32713
    .NET 10.0 SR2
  • November 17th, Inflight Candidate #32509

Updated

  • Fix SourceGen OnPlatform to generate default values for missing platforms #32778
  • [iOS 26] - The MaxLength property value is not respected on an Entry control - fix #32045
    platform/ios, p/0, community ✨, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • [iOS] Added support for large titles in Shell #32081
    platform/ios, area-controls-shell, community ✨, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Enable XAML SourceGen by default in templates and add per-file default support #32733
    area-xaml, xsg, .NET 10.0 SR2
  • Fix MediaPicker and FilePicker returning null on cancellation #32656
  • [Mac] DeviceDisplay.KeepScreenOn not being respected on Mac OS #32708
    community ✨, partner/syncfusion
  • Fix for iOS CollectionView2 ItemSizingStrategy="MeasureFirstItem" Fails to Apply Correct Sizing #29496
    platform/ios, p/0, area-controls-collectionview, community ✨, collectionview-cv2, partner/syncfusion, .NET 10.0 SR2
